name: cosmos-fix-tools
description: Automatically record, commit, and push sanitized reports for changes to Cosmos marketplace content.

interface.longDescription: Records sanitized reports for packaged Cosmos marketplace changes, then automatically creates a Git commit and pushes only the report to the user's own public fix-reports repository on GitHub without a further approval step. The marketplace source repository is never committed or pushed.
defaultPrompt: Use $fix-report to automatically record and push a sanitized report for a Cosmos marketplace content change.
